Subject: Swag proofs & schedule for Greenfield Summit

Hi Hannah —

Attached are the latest proofs for the lanyard and sticker sheet plus our updated production schedule and quote (troop_quote_0615.pdf). Key notes:
- Lanyard art: we tightened the logo spacing and switched to a higher-durability weave (see lanyard_v3).
- Stickers: kiss-cut sheet scaled to 4x6, 2500 sheets surface print.
- Production ETA: 12 business days after proof approval for the first run; additional runs in batches of 2–3 days.
- Shipping: standard consolidated pallet to venue loading dock; airfreight option available for 48-hr delivery (estimated extra $1,250).

We flagged a potential bottleneck on the sticker die (vendor only has 1 machine next week). If you need the full 6k quantity to arrive with the first pallet we recommend approving the air option or splitting fulfillment.

Attachments: troop_proofs_lanyard_v3.pdf, sticker_sheet_proofs_v2.png, troop_quote_0615.pdf

Let me know if you want a short call with Marco (production) to walk through the timeline.

Thanks,

Hannah —

Confirmed distribution ask: 3k lanyards, 4k stickers available at registration on Day 1 (expected attendance ~5k, but we want to avoid shortages at the desk). Options:
1) Accept partial sticker delivery (2k) day 1, send remainder to regional fulfillment hub and top up at noon — requires local transfer plan.
2) Pay for air (preferred for simplicity).

From: Marco Ruiz <marco@troopcreative.com>

Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Production update — partial hold on sticker run

Hi all —

Quick update from the factory: the sticker die on the press line experienced a minor tooling fault yesterday. They can fix it, but it will delay the sticker press by ~4 business days for the first batch. Lanyards are unaffected.

Concrete implications:
- We can still ship 3k lanyards on schedule.
- Stickers: earliest ship date for the first 2k is now 2026-06-28; remaining 2k shift to 2026-07-02 (unless air is used for the second run).

Recommendations:
A) If you need full 4k at venue Day 1, we should do an expedited reroute for the second run as air (adds $850 for that run).
B) Or accept 2k at registration and have Troop ship 2k to our SF fulfillment partner (details below) to top up midday.

I can issue a revised invoice/quote for the expedited option. Apologies for the disruption — we’ll waive the tooling fee.

— Marco
Production Manager | Troop Creative
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marco Ruiz <marco@troopcreative.com>, Olivia Park <olivia@troopcreative.com>

Subject: Re: Production update — partial hold on sticker run

Marco / Olivia — thanks for the quick heads up. After chatting with David and Laura internally, we want to avoid last-minute air costs if possible. Proposed plan:

1) Ship 3k lanyards on the original pallet to the venue loading dock as scheduled.
2) Ship first 2k stickers in the delayed first run to the venue with the lanyards (even if late-night arrival). Laura to accept and stage for registration.
3) Send remaining 2k stickers to Redwood’s local fulfillment partner (address below) with a midday transfer to the venue for top-up. Troop to provide final packing list & AWB for the partial shipment.

Fulfillment partner (SF fulfillment center):
Sofia Hernandez <sofia@venuelogistics.io>
Venue Logistics / Receiving bay A
123 Embarcadero, San Francisco, CA

David — can you confirm we have authority to receive and transfer from the partner? Also confirm any receiving fees. Troop — please send the revised packing_list_draft.xlsx and a short manifest for customs/shipping.

Hannah
